message: An agent permission config grants more than named, scoped actions (a bare or wildcard allow, a bypass or auto default mode, an auto-approve switch or rule, codex approval never with no sandbox, a project env override of the API endpoint, every .mcp.json server enabled without a prompt), a deny entry is gone, or the config cannot be read. Scope the grant (Bash(npm test:*), a named tool list), keep the deny entry, use a mode that asks. Set an API endpoint in your own shell or user-level settings, and name the reviewed servers in enabledMcpjsonServers. A reviewed exception is a {file, path, value} entry under waive in .chock/devenv.json, added by a person in their own commit; in the agent only one already in HEAD counts, so an agent asks the person and never writes it.
